basic_info.description: Probate Sale, Investor Opportunity in Prime Panhandle Location – Victorian Multi-Family Residence  Located in the highly desirable Panhandle neighborhood near Golden Gate Park, this expansive 3,470 sq. ft. Victorian-style Multi- Family Home offers tremendous potential for investors seeking a flip and looking to generate excellent rental income. This multi-family residence features two spacious units, each unit includes four bedrooms, one full bath, a formal living room with a fireplace, and a dining area with a second fireplace, original built-in cabinets, and all original hardwood floors throughout.  Additional highlights include a private garage that has the potential for an ADU garage conversion, separate gate side entrance and a backyard for added outdoor space. Recent improvements include a brand-new roof, ensuring one major project is already taken care of.  The property requires a full renovation team involving kitchen, bathroom, electrical and plumbing and window updates throughout to unlock its full value.   This is an ideal opportunity for savvy investors looking to restore a classic San Francisco Victorian home in a premier location, with the potential for excellent future returns. Don’t miss the chance to reimagine this gem in the heart of San Francisco!
